referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes an electric motor used for an electric passenger car. It is based on direct information from the Swiss manufacturer Brusa. The electric motor has a maximal output power of about 100kW The entries are given as a function of kg device. The specific motor which was used for this dataset weights 53 kg.; UUID: f937e3b1-e1ee-32f8-b582-8a044ad51323
